content_sections.heading: Maitreyi College Non-Teaching Recruitment Eligibility
content_sections.text: Note: Further relaxation in qualifying marks (wherever a minimum percentage is prescribed) is available to SC/ST/OBC/PwD candidates, but only for reserved-category seats – those who apply against unreserved vacancies get no such relaxation.

rows.essential_qualification: Master's Degree with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade; direct recruitment through an All India open competition (written test and interview)

Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University/Institution, plus 3 years' experience as Assistant or equivalent in Level-4 in Central/State Govt./University/PSU/Autonomous Bodies, or equivalent pay package in a reputed private company/corporate bank with minimum annual turnover of ₹200 crore or more; proficiency in Computer Application, noting and drafting
Bachelor's Degree from any recognized Institute/University; English Typing @35 wpm OR Hindi Typing @30 wpm; proficiency in Computer Operations

Bachelor's degree with minimum 2 years' working and maintenance experience of sophisticated scientific instruments in a laboratory, in the relevant subject as decided by the University for the concerned Department; experience in University/Research establishment/Central/State Govt./PSU/Autonomous Body or a private organisation of repute with annual turnover of at least ₹200 crore
10+2 with Science stream from a recognized Central/State Board, OR 10th pass with Science as one subject plus a skill certificate programme in Laboratory Technology or ITI in the relevant trade
10+2 or equivalent from a recognized Board, plus a Certificate course in Library Science from a recognized Institution; candidates will also be assessed for knowledge of Computer Applications

content_sections.heading: Maitreyi College Non-Teaching Recruitment Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection follows the University of Delhi's standard Scheme of Examination for non-teaching posts, which differs by post group. All stages (except Interview) are conducted in a bilingual (English/Hindi) question paper. Preliminary Test cut-off: 50% of the average score of the top 5% of candidates, with 5% relaxation for SC/ST and 10% for PwBD; for most posts (excluding Administrative Officer) the relaxation is calculated on the cut-off derived for UR candidates Negative marking in Preliminary Test: 1 mark per wrong answer for Administrative Officer; 0.5 mark per wrong answer for all other posts Shortlisting ratio for Main: 30 candidates for one vacant post, plus 15 additional candidates for each remaining advertised vacancy (e.g., 45 for two vacancies, 60 for three) 20 minutes extra per hour is given to Visually Impaired, Cerebral Palsy, or similarly placed PwBD candidates in every stage Question papers for Preliminary, Main and Skill Test are bilingual (English/Hindi); the same medium must be used throughout by a candidate

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Maitreyi College Non-Teaching Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit https://dunt.uod.ac.in and register first on the portal. Once registered, log in and fill the complete online application form. Upload the required certificates as per the eligibility conditions for the post applied for. Pay the applicable application fee online as per your category. Applicants applying for more than one post must apply separately and pay fees separately for each. Review all entries carefully – requests for change in any particular of the application form will not be entertained under any circumstances. Submit the application before the last date; candidates are advised to retain a hard copy of the confirmation page and fee payment proof for future reference (not required to be sent to the college). Important: Fees once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances. Applications with incomplete information or without the requisite fee shall be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets relevant to the post Experience certificates, wherever prescribed for the post Caste/category certificate (SC/ST/OBC-NCL) in the prescribed DoPT format, valid for Central Government employment; OBC (NCL) certificate must be issued on or after 01.04.2026 EWS Income and Assets Certificate, issued on or before the last date of application but not earlier than 01.04.2026 Valid Disability Certificate (minimum 40% disability) for candidates claiming PwBD benefits No Objection Certificate (NOC) from employer, for candidates already employed with State/Central Govt./PSU

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Applicants should possess the prescribed qualification and experience as on the closing date of application Mere appearing/qualifying in the Recruitment Test does not entitle a candidate to be called for Interview/Skill Test; it is subject to fulfilment of eligibility and document verification Reserve category candidates who become eligible via age relaxation will be considered only for the reserved seats of their category, even if their merit would otherwise qualify them for UR Canvassing in any form will be treated as disqualification No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the written test/skill test/interview The number/category/recruitment mode of posts advertised may increase/decrease/change; the College reserves the right not to fill up some or all posts The College reserves the right to offer the post at a level lower than advertised/applied, or on contract/deputation basis, depending on qualifications, experience and performance Any dispute is subject to the jurisdiction of Delhi Courts only Any addendum/corrigendum/notification shall be posted only on the College website (www.maitreyi.ac.in); candidates must check regularly Furnishing false, tampered or fabricated particulars, or suppressing material information, will lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage, even after appointment All posts shall be filled as per the Non-Teaching Recruitment Rules of the University of Delhi; qualification and service conditions follow University of Delhi/UGC norms as prescribed from time to time
